title: Pb, Nb, Al: thermal expansion versus anharmonicity in phonon-limited resistivity

decision_points.fork: Which harmonic reference isolates thermal expansion for Al: the archive holds 1-DFPT runs at 50^3, 60^3 and 70^3 fine meshes, the TE runs use 50^3 (visible only in each run's metadata)
decision_points.consequence: Al Delta_TE(481 K) 10.91% instead of 8.94% (+2 points of pure mesh error, outside +-1)

decision_points.fork: Combined TE + anharmonic resistivity from the combined (TDEP at the expanded lattice) physics, or by combining separately estimated TE and 0 K-lattice anharmonic changes
decision_points.consequence: Pb rho(510 K) 43.3 (multiplicative, +17.9%) or 49.5 (additive, +34.7%) instead of 36.72

decision_points.fork: Whether the anharmonic correction is a property of T alone: the 0 K-lattice TDEP runs are withheld, the expanded-lattice TE+anh/TE pairs are released
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the expanded-lattice anharmonic correction for the 0 K lattice
decision_points.consequence: Pb Delta_anh -29.3 / -45.1% instead of -25.2 / -29.5% at 410 / 610 K

decision_points.fork: Which phonon surrogate transfers EPW resistivity ratios: the lab prints the lambda-like <omega^-2> moment; a transport-weighted kernel (|q|^2 (x/sinh x)^2 / omega^2) must be built from the grid and validated on released same-lattice pairs
decision_points.consequence: Pb Delta_anh(410 K) -29.7% (outside +-3) and rho_TE+anh(510 K) 40.1 (+9.2%)

decision_points.fork: Transfer to Nb: the Pb/Al cancellation of TE and anharmonicity and the Pb-validated surrogate calibration do not hold for d-band Nb; its own 1000 K TE+anh run must calibrate the estimate
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume cancellation (TE+anh = harmonic), or reuse the Pb calibration, or hold TE+anh/TE fixed

decision_points.fork: Pb thermal expansion near melting: superlinear growth, with an electronic/deformation-potential residual beyond phonon softening that grows with T
decision_points.wrong_choice: Extrapolate rho_TE linearly, or scale by phonon softening alone

decision_points.fork: SERTA (printed first) vs the converged iterative BTE
The 10 K results are grid-limited (rho 1.57 vs 2.95 micro-Ohm cm for lattices 0.1% apart; Bloch-Gruneisen regime): exclude them from fits and surrogate calibration
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit TE+anh linearly including 10 K, or calibrate the surrogate including the 10 K pair

graded_fields: pb_anharmonic_change_percent_0K_lattice (410, 610 K) within +-3.0 percentage points each

length_estimate.catalog_units: 86 (27 served transport runs x 2 + 32 force-constant sets x 1; phonon requests can be repeated at other grids)
length_estimate.why: Transport lookups across three metals and four conditions, phonon grids for about 15 force-constant sets, building and validating a transport-weighted surrogate, an extrapolation near melting and a Nb-specific calibration.

notes: Adapted from the candidate design (see the construction README): the Nb 1500 K TE+anh output is missing from the archive, so Nb is graded at 2000 K; phonon-moment surrogates miss EPW ratios by 5-17%, so targets are withheld archived values whose defensible estimators (transport-weighted surrogate validated on released pairs, ratio and polynomial extrapolations) agree within the tolerances.

al_te_change_percent_481K.definition: TE run (50^3) / harmonic 50^3 run interpolated quadratically to 481 K

pb_te_resistivity_610K_uohm_cm.oracle_route: q2 surrogate DFPT(a_T)/DFPT(a_0) x residual e(T) linear from 410/510 K

pb_anharmonic_change_percent_0K_lattice.oracle_route: q2 surrogate TDEP(a_0)/DFPT(a_0), calibrated on released 210/310 K TE+anh vs TE pairs

pb_te_anharm_resistivity_510K_uohm_cm.oracle_route: TE(510 K) x q2 surrogate TDEP(510)/DFPT(a_510) / c

nb_te_anharm_resistivity_2000K_uohm_cm.oracle_route: TE(2000 K) x q2 surrogate TDEP/DFPT(a_2000) / c_Nb (Nb 1000 K pair)
